messages.en:
{07 00 00}I tell you, {04 1f 00},
you really are a master
angler!
When it comes to fishing,
I'm leaving it up to you
from now on.
{07 19 00}In fact, maybe it's time for
me to retire,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}
Thanks for playing with me!
And if you ever learn to
talk to the fishes, you let
me know, OK,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ütlen sulle, {04 1f 00},
sa oled tõeline
meisterkalur!
Kui jutt käib kalapüügist,
jätan selle nüüdsest
sinu hooleks.
{07 19 00}Tegelikult on vist aeg
pensionile minna,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}
Aitäh, et minuga mängisid!
Ja kui sa kunagi õpid
kaladega rääkima, anna
mulle teada, eks,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Along those lines,{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 19 00} you
really are a talented
fisher.{07 14 00}
Thanks to you,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0a 00} I've come to
fully understand the true
appeal of sport fishing!
{07 0d 00}Maybe I'll find a new hobby{01 00 00 05 00}
and compete with you again.{01 00 00 05 00}
Let the games begin!
Um...{01 00 00 0a 00} Is that blank stare
your fishing face, {01 00 00 05 00}or just
your competition face?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sellega seoses,{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 19 00} sa oled
tõesti andekas
kalamees.{07 14 00}
Tänu sinule{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0a 00} mõistan nüüd
täielikult kalapüügi
tõelist võlu!
{07 0d 00}Äkki leian uue hobi{01 00 00 05 00}
ja võistlen sinuga uuesti.{01 00 00 05 00}
Las mängud algavad!
Ee...{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas see tühi pilk
on su kalanägu, {01 00 00 05 00}või lihtsalt
võistlusnägu?
